description: START HERE. One call that returns what is live on BlazarForce (Polygon) right now: contract addresses, fees (5 bps wrapper, 30 bps pool), top BlazarSwap pools, BZB price per venue, staking and trading-reward status (e.g. REWARDS_ENDED with date), and which tool to use for what. Use it first in a session, or when unsure which tool fits. For Base / Ethereum support see blazar_chains.
